what: Widespread SaaS price hikes (avg 14% in 2025) and 'SaaS creep' leading companies to replace tools with custom builds or cheaper alternatives. 35% of enterprises already replaced at least one SaaS; 78% plan more. Examples: Zapier overpriced for volume, HubSpot expensive, desire for simple flat-rate or self-hosted alternatives.
why_us: Strong market signal for affordable micro-SaaS or vertical automation tools that undercut incumbents on price while solving specific workflows.
revenue: Potential savings $thousands/year per company; opportunity for $19-49/mo tools
engagement: Industry reports + multiple articles citing Retool 2026 survey
